**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)): DC 46 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 44 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 41 [Morgaran](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2572) **Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 68 **Perception** +30; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [_true seeing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) **Languages** [Abyssal](/Languages.aspx?ID=12), [Celestial](/Languages.aspx?ID=16), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) 100 feet **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +33, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +30, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +30, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +28, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +28 **Str** +8 **Dex** +3 **Con** +5 **Int** +3 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +5 --- **AC** 38 **Fort** +30 **Ref** +26 **Will** +30 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) **HP** 325 **Weaknesses** [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 15, good 15 **Crystal Implant** ([divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The wolf-head shaped crystal implanted in Mogaran's brow pulses with shadowy energy at the start of each of his turns. Any PC who's legendary in [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11), or [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) and sees this can attempt a DC 36 check using one of those skills; on a success, they realize the crystal is manipulating Mogaran's actions in some way. If the crystal is destroyed or deactivated, Mogaran regains control of his actions (with repercussions as detailed on page 68). The crystal functions as a 19th-level magic item for the purposes of [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), but it can also be destroyed by specifically targeting it (AC 40; Hardness 20; HP 90). Alternately, a character can pry the crystal from Mogaran's brow with a successful DC 36 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check, which takes an Interact action, but only if Mogaran is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24).
**[Frightful Presence](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=17)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) 60 feet, DC 35. This aura is suppressed as long as Mogaran's crystal implant is functioning.
**Restoration Vulnerability** Mogaran is repulsed by the restoration of souls. He takes 3d10+10 mental damage the first time each round a creature within 100 feet of him is restored to life or loses the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition. --- **Speed** 40 feet, fly 40 feet **Melee** jaws +33 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d6+14 piercing plus 1d6 evil, 2d8 persistent bleed, and smoking wound **Melee** claw +33 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+14 slashing plus 1d6 evil **Melee** tail +33 ([Backswing](/Traits.aspx?ID=173), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d12+14 bludgeoning plus 1d6 evil and stunning tail **Divine Innate Spells** DC 38 - **4th** [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) (at will) - **5th** [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) - **8th** [Divine Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=81), [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (at will), [Earthquake](/Spells.aspx?ID=95) - **9th** [Massacre](/Spells.aspx?ID=186), [Power Word Stun](/Spells.aspx?ID=228) - **Constant (9th)** [True Seeing](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) **Smoking Wound** A creature damaged by Mogaran's jaws is sickened 1 from the rank smell of vapors from the wound. **Soulfire Breath** ([Death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [Negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) Mogaran exhales ghostly green fire in a 60-foot cone. Living creatures in the area take 18d6 negative damage (DC 38 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A good creature that fails this save becomes [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) for 1 minute (stupefied 4 on a critical failure). A creature slain by Soulfire Breath can't be resurrected except by powerful magic such as a [_wish_](/Spells.aspx?ID=377) spell. Mogaran can't use Soulfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Soulfire Inhalation** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) **Requirements** Mogaran's last action was Soulfire Breath; **Effect** Mogaran inhales and regains 10 Hit Points for each creature damaged by his Soulfire Breath. Any excess healing is gained as temporary Hit Points, which remain for 1 minute. **Stunning Tail** ([Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93)) If Mogaran critically hits with his tail Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save or be [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36) for 1 round (1d4 rounds on a critical failure). **[Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=39)** Large or smaller, claw, DC 38
